system.description:
Your concealment reaches beyond your own form, throwing its veil over a whole group and hiding or disguising them all at once.

Spend one Mental Trait for each subject cloaked, then extend any Obfuscate power you possess over them - masking them with different faces, or letting a group Vanish from the Mind's Eye with a single Mental Challenge. You must meet all the normal conditions of the power you extend. If a cloaked individual violates its provisions (for instance by attacking), only they lose the benefit and the cloak holds; only if you violate it does the whole cloak fail. Likewise, if Auspex detects one hidden person the rest stay concealed, but if you are noticed the cloak collapses. It covers creatures and what they carry, not structures.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
